findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - syncing a repository whose root declares pnpm in `devEngines` and whose web project uses pnpm 8.
A `devEngines.packageManager` object can name pnpm without specifying a version ([npm documentation](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/configuring-npm/package-json/#devengines)). This condition treats that object as a complete decision and skips the tracked nested lockfile. Consequently, the version selection at lines 260-266 cannot read `web/package.json` or its version-6 lockfile and defaults to pnpm 10 instead of pnpm 8. A `web` manifest requiring `engines.pnpm: ^8` then fails when CI installs its dependencies; pnpm enforces the project engine requirement ([pnpm documentation](https://pnpm.io/10.x/package_json#engines)).
Adds work: retain nested version lookup when the root has no pnpm version; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 2
findings.title: Preserve nested pnpm version detection when devEngines has no version

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 2
Case: normal use - checking a fix in a client repository with tens of thousands of files.
The new assertion rejects only the literal `--exclude-standard` option, so an unrestricted listing using other options passes it. Every speed-test variant calls `hooked(repo)`, which sets `repo = "forge-source"` (`tests/test_githooks.py:20`), so the new client lockfile search is skipped in all of them. The generated-file check also still lists every base-tree path through `git ls-tree -rz --name-only` (`src/forge/sync.py:485-489`). Thus the listed proof of no whole-tree Git listing is not established. Exercise the client path on a representative tree and address the remaining listing.
Adds work: cover the client hook on a large tree; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 4
findings.title: Follow-up: Cover whole-tree listings in client hook checks

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 1, Harm 1
Case: normal use - opening the pull request for this fix.
The pull request job runs `forge test --change` (`.github/workflows/forge.yml:88`). Its picker selects changed tests, tests naming changed modules, and their readers (`src/forge/fasttest.py:392-455`). The four listed files `tests/test_upgrade_skips_model_review.py`, `tests/test_client_package_cache.py`, `tests/test_fix_gate_on_split_checks.py`, and `tests/test_release_version.py` are neither selected by those relationships for this diff nor listed in `.forge/always-tests.txt`. The PR check therefore will not provide their results, including the nested-lockfile upgrade and generated-file compatibility checks. Run those named proofs as requested.
Adds work: run the four listed compatibility checks; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 2

why: The commit hook's generated-file check now lists every file in the repo to look for a nested pnpm lockfile, which makes the hook slower and fails the Windows speed test, blocking the v1.2.41 release.
